source:
@@U02485@@
So honor him to whom honor is due,
and praise him who brought us to this!

@@U02487@@
Where rich and brightly shining ore
Threads its way through mountain core,
Only the divining rod can
Open the maze to the eyes of man.
We live in dark caves underground,
Like troglodytes, where no sun’s found,
While up above in day’s pure light
You give to man your treasures bright.
But now, nearby, we've found a treasure
Of so great wealth it’s beyond measure;
A source so grand we never thought
To see its like from deep earth brought.
It’s yours to bring this to fulfillment,
Lord, to save it from concealment;
Treasure in the Great Pan’s hand
Brings benefit to every land.

@@U02489@@
(To the HERALD.)

@@U02490@@
Let us compose ourselves now
with great solemnity
and allow to happen what will happen,
for you have proven yourself
a man supremely valiant.
A thing of such calamity is about to occur
that the world and the world’s posterity will deny it
even to the end of time.
And so, it’s for you to record it in your chronicle.

@@U02492@@
(Grasping the staff which 普路托斯 continues to hold.)

@@U02493@@
The dwarfs now, with enormous care,
lead Great Pan to the fiery spring
that seethes up from its gaping abyss,
IDO (AOE Wise
translation:
@@U02485@@
因此，请尊重应得荣誉的人，
并赞美他把我们带到了这一步！

@@U02487@@
那里蕴藏着丰富而闪亮的矿石
蜿蜒穿过山心，
只有占卜棒可以
打开人类眼前的迷宫。
我们生活在黑暗的地下洞穴里，
就像穴居人一样，那里找不到太阳，
在白天纯净的光线下
你将你的宝藏明亮地给予人类。
但现在，在附近，我们发现了宝藏
如此巨大的财富是难以估量的；
一个我们从未想到过的伟大来源
看到它就像是从地球深处带来的。
实现这一目标的责任在于你，
主啊，请将其从隐藏中拯救出来；
大盘手中的宝藏
为每一个土地带来好处。

@@U02489@@
（致《先驱报》）

@@U02490@@
现在让我们平静下来
郑重地
并允许将要发生的事情发生，
因为你已经证明了自己
一个极其勇敢的人。
这样的灾难即将发生
世界和世界的子孙后代都会否认这一点
甚至到时间的尽头。
所以，你要把它记录在你的编年史中。

@@U02492@@
（握住普路托斯继续握着的手杖。）

@@U02493@@
现在，小矮人们非常小心，
带领大盘走向火泉
从其张开的深渊中沸腾起来，
IDO（AOE 明智
